node.statement: For D=sum_{gamma,sigma} q_{gamma,sigma} W_{gamma,sigma}^dagger tensor W_{gamma,sigma}, the identity 2^(-m) sum_sigma sigma_r sigma_s=1 when r=s and 0 otherwise, together with the block Weyl averages, gives D=sum_r iota_r tensor iota_r(D_{d_r}); thus all cross-block tensor components vanish exactly.
